config.ponents.ner.min_name_len.description: Minimum detection length (found terms/mentions shorter than this will not be detected).

config.ponents.ner.upper_case_limit_len.description: All detected terms shorter than this value have to be uppercase, otherwise they will be ignored.

config.ponents.linking.similarity_thresh.description: If the confidence of the model is lower than this a detection will be ignore.

config.ponents.linking.filters.cuis.description: Length of the CUIs filter to be included in outputs. If this is not 0 (i.e. not empty) its best to check what is included before using the model

config.general.spell_check_len_limit.description: Words shorter than this will not be spell checked.
